newsitem.title: USA: Enron, Portland Gen boards revise merger.
newsitem.headline: Enron, Portland Gen boards revise merger.

text.p: Enron Corp said revised terms for its acquisition of Portland General Corp have been approved by directors of both companies.

The revision includes $141 million of merger-related benefits for Portland General's customers and reduces the number of shares Portland General holders will receive in the merger, Enron said in a statement.
The revision calls for 0.9825 Enron share to be exchanged for each Portland General share. The previous agreement called for a one-to-one exchange.
The amended agreement requires Portland General shareholder approval, Enron said, noting a vote is currently scheduled for the utility's annual meeting on June 24.

After careful consideration of the various alternatives, the Portland General board "has determined that this course of action represents the best alternative available" to the company's shareholders, chief executive Ken Harrison said.
